label: Website Capture API
title: Website Capture API: Screenshot, PDF, MP4 & GIF
metaDescription: Capture any web page as JPEG, PNG, PDF, MP4 or GIF: 131 phone and tablet presets, full-page capture, signed-in sessions, endless-feed scrolling.
intro: Capture any web page as a JPEG, PNG, PDF, MP4 or GIF, with 131 phone and tablet presets, full-page capture, signed-in sessions through cookies, and scrolling that stops cleanly on endless feeds.
useCases: Archive pages as PDF for compliance
Record a scrolling video of a landing page
Check how a site looks on many phones

faq.a: JPEG, PNG, PDF, MP4 and GIF, full page or viewport, with 131 phone and tablet presets.

faq.q: Can I use it as a website screenshot API?
faq.a: Yes. Start a run from your own code with Apify's REST API (or the JavaScript and Python clients) and read the results as JSON; the run-sync endpoint returns the items in the same HTTP call. The same input also runs in the Apify Console, on a schedule, or from Make, Zapier and n8n.
